guideline.name: 디지털 정부서비스 UI/UX 가이드라인
guideline.changeSummary: 컴포넌트와 서비스 패턴 사용성 가이드라인 수정

documentation.versionBoundary: Live pages can change independently of the pinned 2025.08 PDF and are evidence only as checkedAt.

license.name: 공공누리 제1유형 (KOGL Type 1)
license.attribution: 본 저작물은 행정안전부에서 작성하여 공공누리 제1유형으로 개방한 KRDS(Korea Design System) 자료를 이용하였으며, 원문은 https://www.krds.go.kr/에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

accessibilityBoundary.statement: KRDS component use supports accessibility work but does not by itself prove complete accessibility conformance.
accessibilityBoundary.projectStandard: WCAG 2.2 A and AA plus approved KWCAG and KRDS mappings

verifiedScopeRequires: all applicable mapping entries adopted or an approved non-stale exception
manual keyboard, screen reader, reflow, forced-colors and reduced-motion evidence
identity eligibility and attribution approval when identity elements are enabled

profiles.purpose: 공식 공공 디지털 서비스용 표준형 후보
requirements: approved masthead, identifier, header and footer content

profiles.purpose: KRDS 원칙·패턴을 채택하고 기관별 시각 확장을 허용하는 후보
참조 구현과 비공공 파생 제품용 선택 프로필
requirements: same semantic, state, interaction and accessibility floor

mapping.title: 사용자 중심의 서비스
mapping.notes: Principle is adopted; actual user-research results remain blocked-input.

mapping.title: 모든 사용자를 포용하는 서비스
mapping.notes: Adopted as a requirement, not a conformance claim.

mapping.title: 일관성과 사용자 선택을 함께 보장
mapping.deviation: Brand profile and color mode are modeled as independent axes rather than one visual theme.
mapping.notes: Rendered parity is not yet proven.

mapping.title: 색상과 상태 의미
mapping.deviation: Current single token set uses Hub Blue and is not the KRDS standard palette; semantic roles and contrast ratchets are retained.
mapping.notes: Task 2.2 must implement profile-specific adapters before any standard-profile claim.

mapping.title: 타이포그래피
mapping.reason: The current app uses Pretendard Variable, Inter and Outfit; Pretendard GOV and profile-specific hierarchy have not been evaluated.

mapping.title: 형태
mapping.reason: Current premium radii and KRDS standard/adaptive shape scales have not been separated by profile.

mapping.title: 레이아웃과 반응형 reflow
mapping.deviation: The contract targets task-preserving reflow, while route-level rendered evidence is tracked separately.

mapping.title: 아이콘
mapping.deviation: The current app uses Lucide icons rather than the KRDS asset set; accessible name, consistency and non-text contrast remain mandatory.
mapping.notes: Asset substitution requires visual and licensing review.

mapping.title: 엘리베이션
mapping.deviation: Premium shadow and blur recipes remain profile-specific; high-contrast separation must use borders.

mapping.title: 선명한 화면 모드
mapping.reason: Current dark mode is not equivalent to the KRDS high-contrast mode and forced-colors evidence is missing.

mapping.title: primitive-semantic-component token architecture
mapping.deviation: Local semantic token names are stable adapters; upstream token files are not copied wholesale.
mapping.notes: Upstream values must be introduced through a versioned profile adapter.

mapping.title: 공식 배너
mapping.reason: This repository is a reference implementation and has no approved official-service eligibility or institution content.

mapping.title: 비공식 프로필의 공식 배너 금지
mapping.reason: KRDS explicitly prohibits the official banner on services that are not official government services.

mapping.title: 헤더·푸터·운영기관 식별자
mapping.reason: Generic shell components exist, but institution identity, policy links, contact details and exact KRDS ordering are unapproved.

mapping.title: 본문 바로가기
mapping.notes: Current shell provides the link before repeated shell content and a focusable main target; browser evidence remains part of Task 0.5.

mapping.title: 버튼·링크
mapping.deviation: Local Radix/shadcn-derived primitives are retained; semantics, names, keyboard operation and target size are mapped instead of copying markup classes.

mapping.title: 입력·선택·날짜 컨트롤
mapping.deviation: Existing React primitives are mapped by semantic and interaction contract; exact KRDS markup and all error states are not yet proven.

mapping.title: 구조화 목록·표·페이지 탐색
mapping.deviation: StandardDataTable is a local composite with desktop table, mobile cards, state and pagination contracts.
mapping.notes: Dense-list pilot and responsive semantics must be verified before scope approval.

mapping.title: 피드백·오류·상태
mapping.deviation: Local state components preserve error/empty distinctions; complete focus and live-region coverage is pending.
mapping.notes: Do not infer accessibility conformance from component presence.

mapping.title: 목록 탐색
mapping.deviation: Local dense-list patterns retain product-specific columns and card transformations.
mapping.notes: Task success and AT evidence are unmeasured.

mapping.title: 필터링·정렬
mapping.deviation: Server and local filtering contracts vary by domain and must disclose scope.
mapping.notes: Filtered-zero and focus-after-update are pilot gates.

mapping.title: 오류와 입력 보존
mapping.notes: Policy is adopted; route-level implementation evidence remains incomplete.

mapping.title: 입력 폼
mapping.deviation: Shared validation primitives exist, but section heading, required-field, error focus and long-content behavior vary by route.
mapping.notes: Composer and wizard pilots own proof.

mapping.title: 개인 식별 정보 입력
mapping.reason: Field-level purpose, minimization, masking, retention and analytics rules require domain and privacy-owner approval.

mapping.title: 로그인
mapping.deviation: Current reference login supports one credential method; identity recovery and approved session-extension policy are outside current evidence.
mapping.notes: Authentication security policy outranks visual pattern matching.

mapping.title: 검색
mapping.deviation: The current route has role/API asymmetry and unsupported article search; capability truth takes precedence.
mapping.notes: It cannot be treated as a complete KRDS search journey.

mapping.title: 신청·다단계 입력
mapping.reason: No product owner has selected an application journey as an applicable public-service pilot; generic wizard styling cannot establish applicability.

mapping.title: 정책 정보 확인
mapping.reason: Help and policy routes exist, but current content ownership, freshness and direct-detail journey evidence are unapproved.

mapping.title: KRDS 자체 검증 체크리스트
mapping.reason: The official checklist has not been executed against an approved profile-route-state population.

refreshTriggers.action: fail the mapping contract until checkedAt/checkBy and affected entries are reviewed

refreshTriggers.condition: official resource page lists a guideline newer than 2025.08
refreshTriggers.action: diff changed principles, components and service patterns before updating the pinned version

refreshTriggers.condition: official component kit release differs from 1.1.0
refreshTriggers.action: review assets, markup, accessibility notes and license before adoption

refreshTriggers.condition: brand profile, masthead, identifier, header or footer eligibility changes
refreshTriggers.action: require product/institution approval and rerun identity mapping

refreshTriggers.condition: project WCAG/KWCAG target or official KRDS accessibility mapping changes
refreshTriggers.action: refresh success-criterion coverage and manual test matrix
